# Shared fixtures

These synthetic fixtures document and exercise current contracts. Select them
by content rather than implementation history:

| Directory | Content |
| --- | --- |
| [protocol](protocol/README.md) | BYOS request headers, response bodies and authenticated image requests |
| [render-context](render-context/README.md) | Context v1 JSON shared by HTTP POST and Job renderers |
| [png](png/README.md) | Accepted grayscale and indexed gray4 image inputs |

Fixture identities and credentials are fabricated. These files are not device
captures or physical-device acceptance evidence. See
[PROTOCOL](../notes/PROTOCOL.md) for the owning contracts and
[DEVELOP](../notes/DEVELOP.md#recorded-acceptance-baseline) for dated acceptance.
